title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-12
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > Dat (16/44.1k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 (.wav 16/44.1k) > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Decent matrix‑style composite recording with minor pitch and edit quirks, but the show shines thanks to a monster Alligator → Caution stretch and strong organ work.
ai_review.review: The source is a mixed‑source composite that has been re‑pitched and balanced, giving generally clear audio though it runs slightly fast and contains a few reel‑flip edits. Musically the night is uneven – early songs stumble, but the second set delivers a high‑energy Alligator into an epic 24‑minute Caution, plus standout organ on Dire Wolf and a memorable Lovelight. Overall listeners love the psychedelic peaks while noting some loose moments in the first half.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is rated high (≈4) due to praised Alligator/Caution and organ highlights, while recording quality is solid but with noted speed/pitch issues (≈3). Weighted average yields ~3.8.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Composite of best sources, re‑pitched and balanced; runs about -1% fast requiring pitch correction, contains a few reel‑flip edits and occasional dropouts but overall clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set is uneven with tempo slips, but the second set builds into a powerful, lengthy Alligator → Caution jam and finishes strong with Bid.

band_member_comments.Phil: Starts Dark Star but it never fully launches; otherwise no specific remarks.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ on Dire Wolf and Uncle John's Band is highlighted as a strong feature of the night.
band_member_comments.Drums: Hard to Handle described as 'drummer's soup' with loose playing, while later drumming improves after the Alligator segment.
